## Problem

What is wrong or missing, and who is affected.

## Behavior

What changes for users and operators. Include new settings, defaults, and error codes.

## Design decisions

Why this approach. Note alternatives that were rejected and public API changes.

## Validation

Commands run and results. Say which new tests failed before the change and which could not,
and anything that was not verified.

## Limitations

List every material limitation. File one issue per limitation (label `limitation`), link it here
and from the limitations index issue (#13). Write "None" only if there are none.

- [ ] Each limitation above has its own issue and is linked from the index.
- [ ] Issues fixed by this PR are closed with `Fixes #N`.
